newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News no comment on League damages.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News no comment on League damages.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said on Friday it could not comment on the amount of damages it would pay the Australian Rugby League (ARL), the sport's local ruling body, for the disruption caused by its attempt to create a rebel Super League.
"I don't want to comment on that, it's back before the court," said Ken Cowley, the executive chairman of News Ltd, at a news conference.
News Ltd is the Australian division of News Corp.
Earlier on Friday, Australia's Federal Court ruled that News Ltd would have to pay damages to the ARL due to the disruption caused in the 1995 season which ended last weekend.
The court ruled in favour of an appeal by Rupert Murdoch's media group against an earlier court decision barring the rebel league until the end of the century.
The ruling applies only to the 1995 season, not the just completed 1996 season which was disrupted by the legal battle between the ARL and Super League over the future of rugby league.
